postmortems.name: RDW
postmortems.what_happened: The short (RDW against XLI, industrials ETF) was stopped on its first session, down 10.4% at 3:45 PM ET. RDW rose about 12% with the whole space group (RKLB +10.9%, ASTS +14.1%, FLY +17.1%) on NASA's CLPS 2 lunar awards of 11-07, the $1.3B Firefly-AST engine deal of 11-06 and a +2.4% SPY day. No Redwire news was found; the reason for the short (a revenue miss of $109.0M against $125-136M, four target cuts) was not contradicted. Short interest was about 18.6% of float, and XLI moved nothing like the space group.
postmortems.lesson: A short in a small, heavily shorted theme stock hedged with a broad sector fund carries the theme's whole move; check the group's news since the signal and hedge with what it trades with, or pass.
